title: Reduce the complete standards socket below 100,000 lines without capability loss
goal: Keep the complete generic standards socket below 100,000 physical runtime Rust lines. Concrete implementations belong in separately hosted implementation packages; retain capabilities through verified standard-protocol connections. Runtime and current documentation are identity-neutral. Operational history and evidence belong outside source.

reuse.searched: Existing standard-protocol contracts and implementation hosts; destination-first parity before removing core implementations.
